_about: Settings of the rules. Change a value, then run `node tools/build.js` for a new offline file. A country file (config/countries/<CC>.json) can override any value under "settings". Durations are ISO 8601 (P1M = one calendar month, P30D, PT1H); amounts are strings; null switches a check off. See docs/RULES.md, section Settings.

checks._about: Per check id (or id-part, e.g. 4.2-age): enabled (true/false), severity (E, W, I), code (ISO reason code). Only list what differs from the rule. Stages 0 and 1 stop the run and cannot be changed here.

4.2-age._why: Decided 2026-11-18: a file older than the maximum age is a warning.

7.13._why: Review 2026-11-19: a payment between two accounts of one country in a foreign currency (for example USD in CZ) may be allowed; a warning until confirmed with the bank's files.

4.30-lines._why: Merge 2026-11-18: 6.3 limits the address lines of every address (guideline.maxOccurs PstlAdr/AdrLine), so the same problem is not reported twice.

paymentTypes._about: Codes used to derive the payment type of a transaction (docs/specs/M2.md, section 2).

charsets._about: Allowed characters as a regular expression character class. 5.1 uses sepa for SEPA payments, swiftX for cross-border, the country's characterSet for the others.

guideline._about: CMIplus usage guideline (stage 6) and other bank-specific choices. The values are assumptions until confirmed against CMIplus.

maxLength._note: RmtInf/Ustrd: 140 is the XSD limit already.

hints._about: Stage 10. truncateLength: { "path": length } of texts CMIplus shortens (10.3, paths as in guideline.maxLength). recommend: the parts of 10.6. nearLimitShare: 10.9 from this share of a limit. version03: 10.8 on .03 files (only where the country also accepts .09).
